# rerank_mmr { #dyf.rerank_mmr }

```python
rerank_mmr(query_emb, candidate_indices, embeddings_normed, top_k, lam=0.5)
```

Maximal Marginal Relevance re-ranking.

## Iteratively selects candidates that maximize {.doc-section .doc-section-iteratively-selects-candidates-that-maximize}

lam * sim(query, doc) - (1-lam) * max_sim(doc, already_selected)

## Parameters {.doc-section .doc-section-parameters}

| Name              | Type   | Description                                        | Default    |
|-------------------|--------|----------------------------------------------------|------------|
| query_emb         |        | (d,) normalized query embedding.                   | _required_ |
| candidate_indices |        | 1-D array of candidate point indices.              | _required_ |
| embeddings_normed |        | (n, d) L2-normalized embedding matrix.             | _required_ |
| top_k             |        | Number of results to return.                       | _required_ |
| lam               |        | Relevance-diversity tradeoff (1 = pure relevance). | `0.5`      |

## Returns {.doc-section .doc-section-returns}

| Name   | Type   | Description                           |
|--------|--------|---------------------------------------|
|        |        | np.ndarray of selected point indices. |
